name: application-queue-list
title: Queue List
description: A "Now playing" row with an animated equalizer, followed by a reorderable "Up next" queue of tracks with drag handles, durations, and hover-revealed remove buttons.
useWhen: Music, podcast, or video players that need an editable up-next queue distinct from the currently-playing track.
Users should be able to reorder or remove queued items without leaving the player context.
avoidWhen: The list is a fixed, non-reorderable curated playlist — use `Lesson Playlist` or a plain list instead of implying drag-to-reorder.
There's no active 'now playing' concept — a plain reorderable list without the now-playing header is simpler.
responsiveBehavior: The now-playing row and queue items share the same width and stack vertically at all sizes; truncate long titles/artists rather than wrapping to preserve row height.
accessibility: The drag handle is a real button with an aria-label ("Drag to reorder"), reachable and nameable without a pointer.
The remove button carries an aria-label ("Remove from queue") since only an icon is shown, and should remain keyboard-focusable even though it's visually hover-revealed.
The equalizer animation is decorative; the now-playing state should also be conveyed via an aria-live region or text status in a real implementation.

variants.title: Up next queue
variants.description: A now-playing row (album art, play icon, animated equalizer bars) above three reorderable queue tracks, each with a drag handle, colored album art, title/artist, duration, and a hover-revealed remove button.
accessibility: Drag handles and remove buttons both carry descriptive aria-labels.

variants.title: Up next queue (Dark)
variants.description: Queue list adapted for dark surfaces, including the now-playing highlight and equalizer bar color.
accessibility: Track text and duration meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark queue background.
